q-0010.answer:
Here are relevant duas from our collection:

• Dua for a righteous spouse (Quran 25:74) (Dua marriage-1)
رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous
(Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama)
Source: Quran 25:74

• Dua when seeking marriage (Hadith) (Dua marriage-2)
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
O Allah, I ask You for her good and the good of what You have created her upon, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of what You have created her upon
(Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa khayra ma jubilat 'alayhi wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jubilat 'alayhi)
Source: Sunan Abu Dawud 2155, Sunan Ibn Majah 1892

q-0458.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Qiyaama (75) — The Resurrection · 40 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• He says when will the Day of Judgement be? His question is only a question of denying its occurrence, and rejecting its existence.
• The Cause of rejecting the Day of Judgement is Love of the World and Heedlessness of the Hereafter
• Mentioning the Case of the Denier
• He will be a witness against himself, knowing full well what he did, even though he will try to make excuses and deny it.

q-0634.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Transliteration: Wa azaanum minal laahi wa Rasooliheee ilan naasi yawmal Hajjil Akbari annal laaha bareee'um minal mushrikeena wa Rasooluh; fa-in tubtum fahuwa khairullakum wa in tawallaitum fa'lamooo annakum ghairu mu'jizil laah; wa bashiril lazeena kafaroo biazaabin aleem

Translation: And [it is] an announcement from Allah and His Messenger to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage that Allah is disassociated from the disbelievers, and [so is] His Messenger. So if you repent, that is best for you; but if you turn away - then know that you will not cause failure to Allah. And give tidings to those who disbelieve of a painful punishment.
